text:
sam_support: Heads up — customer reports SSE stream returns 401 after token rotation. request id req-9f3c1a2b. Works for ~30s then 401. Need a minimal curl repro + trace so infra can correlate.

meera_eng: Do we know auth type? JWT access/refresh flow or cookie/HMAC?

sam_support: Customer says JWT refresh. They sent a quick curl but it doesn't include x-request-id or raw headers. Posting what they used: 

sam_support: ```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-large \
  --no-buffer
```

jon_infra: Please ask them to add `-i` (show raw headers) and `--trace-ascii /tmp/trace.txt`. Also include `X-Request-ID: req-9f3c1a2b` header so we can match the server logs. If they use cookies, include the exact Cookie header value.

sam_support: Good call. I'll request the trace file + raw headers and ask them to run the curl with the explicit x-request-id. Also ask to run `curl --no-buffer -i --trace-ascii trace.txt` and attach trace.txt.

deploybot: support-bundle triggered: run `support-bundle collect --req req-9f3c1a2b` to pull ingress, auth-service, and rotation events. ETA ~5m :gear:

meera_eng: One more thing — proxies sometimes rebuffer SSE and cause auth re-eval. Ask them to try toggling `Accept: text/event-stream` vs `Accept: text/plain` and try `-H "Connection: close"` to exercise proxy behavior quickly.

sam_support: Draft repro instructions I'll send to the customer — please sanity-check: 

sam_support: ```
# replace $TOKEN and $COOKIE with values from your session, redact before sharing
curl -v -i \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req-9f3c1a2b" \
  -H "Cookie: $COOKIE" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-large \
  --no-buffer --trace-ascii ./trace.txt
```

sam_support: Ask them to attach `trace.txt` and the curl stdout (-i) output. Tell them to include the timestamp when they perform a refresh (refresh request id if available).

liz_cust_success: Please also request the approximate clock skew between their machines and UTC if possible — helps with correlating rotation events.

sam_support: Will do. I'll update the thread once we have the trace bundle. Thanks all.
